context: This criteria evaluates proper error handling and custom response validation in HTTP requests.

checklist.name: Error catching
checklist.description: Properly catches and handles errors using callback error parameter or promise .catch()

checklist.name: Error property access
checklist.description: Accesses error object properties such as .status, .response, or .message to extract error details

checklist.name: Custom validation
checklist.description: Uses the .ok() method to implement custom response validation logic that overrides default success criteria
